review.summary: Full re-review with brute-force scripts + scan comparison. Script-verified: Q16 (two solutions, leftovers 2+1=3), Q17 (99572), Q20 (351), Q22 (unique, Jerry rock=5), Q23 (max black = 10, exhaustive over 2^16 boards — prior optimality nit RESOLVED), Q24 (links 3→13/7→11/10→8/14→5 read off the scan; simulation confirms pairs (2,1)/(4,1)/(6,3) → 24, and the given 6-6-4/6-6-5 facts — prior figure nit RESOLVED), Q25 (unique grid solution ●=7 ♦=8 ★=5 → 10 — prior nit RESOLVED). Hand-verified: Q1, Q2 (4+9=13 vs scan), Q5 (116), Q6 (32), Q7 (2&3), Q8 (10 strip rects − 3 squares + 4 goal boxes + 2 outer goals = 13), Q9 (6+8+8=22 vs scan), Q10 (12), Q11 (87), Q15 (each roll = 120°+60° = 180° → 2 orientations), Q21 (unique balance at 21, checked all cars in both rows). Fixed this pass: Q3 steps/trap (scan path is down 3 rows + across 4 cells = 3+8=11, not 5+6) and the AntPath component; Q19 component (scan omits the middle-left stick — 15 sticks, 6 unit + 2 size-2 triangles = 8, min removal 4, so 12 stands; component wrongly drew 16 sticks which would give 10 triangles); Q13 option glyphs re-tuned so M genuinely has the most right angles; Q14 component re-ordered to match the scan (bottom row ▼ ◁ ▲ engine→). One open defect: Q18.

findings.note: Equation (1) □4+□4+□8+□9+□7=901 (append 0s to each digit) has NO solution as transcribed — exhaustively script-checked over 0..5 zeros per digit. Equation (2) □5+□7+□1−□8=95 has the unique solution 5+70+100−80=95 using 4 zeros, so the stored answer 7 requires equation (1) to use exactly 3 zeros. OCR-repair search found multiple one/two-digit variants that admit solutions (e.g. digits {4,4,8,9,3}: 4+4+800+90+3=901 with 3 zeros, but also a second 5-zero solution), so no reconstruction is provably unique. Keep answer 7 (official key) but the stem needs re-transcription from the original PDF before this question is deploy-clean.

questions.body_en: Which result is the same as 7 × 9 − 7?
questions.body_id: Hasil mana yang sama dengan 7 × 9 − 7?
hint_steps_en: First do the multiplication: 7 × 9 = 63.
Then take away 7: 63 − 7 = 56.
Which choice equals 56? 7 × 8 = 56 → D.
hint_steps_id: Kerjakan perkalian dulu: 7 × 9 = 63.
Lalu kurangi 7: 63 − 7 = 56.
Pilihan mana yang sama dengan 56? 7 × 8 = 56 → D.

highlights.note_en: Work this out, then look for a matching choice.
highlights.note_id: Hitung ini, lalu cari pilihan yang sama.

strategy.name_en: Compute the expression, then match it to a product
strategy.name_id: Hitung ekspresinya, lalu cocokkan dengan hasil kali

trap.why_en: 7 × 7 = 49, not 56 — taking away one 7 leaves eight 7s, which is 7 × 8.
trap.why_id: 7 × 7 = 49, bukan 56 — mengambil satu 7 menyisakan delapan 7, yaitu 7 × 8.

questions.body_en: How many centimeters should the shaded triangle be moved rightward to make the parallelogram become a rectangle?
questions.body_id: Berapa sentimeter segitiga yang diarsir harus digeser ke kanan agar jajargenjang berubah menjadi persegi panjang?
hint_steps_en: The slanted left side has a triangle whose base is 4 cm.
The flat part of the bottom is 9 cm long.
To make a rectangle, slide the triangle all the way across: 4 + 9 = 13.
So it moves 13 cm → D.
hint_steps_id: Sisi kiri yang miring punya segitiga dengan alas 4 cm.
Bagian datar alasnya panjangnya 9 cm.
Untuk membuat persegi panjang, geser segitiga sepenuhnya: 4 + 9 = 13.
Jadi bergeser 13 cm → D.

questions.body_en: Each vertical column has 8 rectangles and each horizontal row has 9 rectangles. If there are 7 gray rectangles, how many white rectangles are there?
questions.body_id: Setiap kolom vertikal memiliki 8 persegi panjang dan setiap baris horizontal memiliki 9 persegi panjang. Jika ada 7 persegi panjang abu-abu, ada berapa persegi panjang putih?
hint_steps_en: The grid is 8 tall and 9 wide, so there are 8 × 9 = 72 little rectangles.
7 of them are gray.
White = all − gray = 72 − 7 = 65 → E.
hint_steps_id: Kisi setinggi 8 dan selebar 9, jadi ada 8 × 9 = 72 persegi panjang kecil.
7 di antaranya abu-abu.
Putih = semua − abu-abu = 72 − 7 = 65 → E.

questions.body_en: Grade 2 students planned to plant 226 trees in a park. In the end, the boys planted 62 trees and the girls planted 14 fewer trees than the boys. Find the difference between the number of trees they planted and the number of trees they planned to plant.
questions.body_id: Siswa kelas 2 berencana menanam 226 pohon di taman. Pada akhirnya, para siswa laki-laki menanam 62 pohon dan para siswa perempuan menanam 14 pohon lebih sedikit dari siswa laki-laki. Tentukan selisih antara jumlah pohon yang mereka tanam dan jumlah pohon yang mereka rencanakan.
hint_steps_en: Girls planted 14 fewer than the boys: 62 − 14 = 48.
So they planted 62 + 48 = 110 trees in all.
They had planned 226, so the difference is 226 − 110 = 116 → B.
hint_steps_id: Perempuan menanam 14 lebih sedikit dari laki-laki: 62 − 14 = 48.
Jadi mereka menanam 62 + 48 = 110 pohon seluruhnya.
Mereka merencanakan 226, jadi selisihnya 226 − 110 = 116 → B.

highlights.note_id: Ini jumlah yang direncanakan.

highlights.phrase_id: para siswa perempuan menanam 14 pohon lebih sedikit dari siswa laki-laki

questions.body_en: According to the timetable, the first train departs at 06:10, and afterwards a train comes every 48 minutes. Due to technical problems, the first train departs at 06:26 today, and the other trains still depart at their normal scheduled times. How many minutes are there between the departure times of the first train and the second train today?
questions.body_id: Menurut jadwal, kereta pertama berangkat pukul 06:10, dan setelah itu kereta datang setiap 48 menit. Karena masalah teknis, kereta pertama hari ini berangkat pukul 06:26, dan kereta-kereta lainnya tetap berangkat sesuai jadwal normal. Berapa menit selisih waktu keberangkatan kereta pertama dan kereta kedua hari ini?
hint_steps_en: Normally the second train is 48 minutes after 06:10, which is 06:58.
Only the first train is late; the second still leaves at 06:58.
Today the first left at 06:26, so the gap is 06:58 − 06:26 = 32 minutes, choice C.
hint_steps_id: Biasanya kereta kedua 48 menit setelah 06:10, yaitu 06:58.
Hanya kereta pertama yang terlambat; kereta kedua tetap berangkat 06:58.
Hari ini kereta pertama berangkat 06:26, jadi selisihnya 06:58 − 06:26 = 32 menit, pilihan C.

highlights.phrase_id: kereta pertama berangkat pukul 06:10
highlights.note_en: The normal schedule starts here.

highlights.phrase_id: kereta datang setiap 48 menit

highlights.note_id: Jadi kereta kedua 48 menit setelah waktu jadwal pertama.

questions.body_en: Maggi has two $30 bills, two $5 bills, and four $1 bills. After she buys two items, there are 20-something dollars left. The four items and their prices are: Item ①: $25, Item ②: $38, Item ③: $15, Item ④: $19. Which two items might she buy?
questions.body_id: Maggi memiliki dua lembar uang $30, dua lembar uang $5, dan empat lembar uang $1. Setelah membeli dua barang, sisa uangnya sekitar 20-an dolar. Keempat barang dan harganya adalah: Barang ①: $25, Barang ②: $38, Barang ③: $15, Barang ④: $19. Dua barang mana yang mungkin ia beli?
hint_steps_en: She starts with 2x30 + 2x5 + 4x1 = $74.
She has 20-something left, so she spent between $45 and $54.
Try items 2 and 3: 38 + 15 = 53; change = 74 − 53 = $21, yes.
So she buys items 2 and 3, choice C.
hint_steps_id: Ia mulai dengan 2x30 + 2x5 + 4x1 = $74.
Sisanya 20-an, jadi ia membelanjakan antara $45 dan $54.
Coba barang 2 dan 3: 38 + 15 = 53; kembalian = 74 − 53 = $21, ya.
Jadi ia membeli barang 2 dan 3, pilihan C.

questions.body_en: Amy, Ben, and Carol participate in a basketball shooting competition. The player who makes the most total shots in three rounds wins. Their results: Amy scored 15 in Round 1 and 24 in Round 2; Ben scored 16 in Round 1, 21 in Round 2, and has a total of 52; Carol scored 14 in Round 1, 17 in Round 2, and 19 in Round 3. If Ben gets first place, Amy gets second place, and Carol gets third place, how many shots does Amy make in Round 3?
questions.body_id: Amy, Ben, dan Carol ikut kompetisi tembakan bola basket. Pemain yang mencetak total tembakan terbanyak dalam tiga babak menang. Hasilnya: Amy mencetak 15 di Babak 1 dan 24 di Babak 2; Ben mencetak 16 di Babak 1, 21 di Babak 2, dan total 52; Carol mencetak 14 di Babak 1, 17 di Babak 2, dan 19 di Babak 3. Jika Ben juara pertama, Amy juara kedua, dan Carol juara ketiga, berapa tembakan yang Amy lakukan di Babak 3?
hint_steps_en: Ben total is 52 and Carol total is 14 + 17 + 19 = 50.
Amy is second, so her total is more than 50 but less than 52, exactly 51.
Amy already has 15 + 24 = 39, so Round 3 = 51 − 39 = 12, choice A.
hint_steps_id: Total Ben 52 dan total Carol 14 + 17 + 19 = 50.
Amy juara kedua, jadi totalnya lebih dari 50 tetapi kurang dari 52, tepat 51.
Amy sudah punya 15 + 24 = 39, jadi Babak 3 = 51 − 39 = 12, pilihan A.

questions.body_en: The combined weight of A and B is 23 kg heavier than C. The combined weight of B and C is 27 kg heavier than A. The combined weight of C and A is 37 kg heavier than B. Find the sum of the weights of A, B, and C in kg.
questions.body_id: Gabungan berat A dan B lebih berat 23 kg dari C. Gabungan berat B dan C lebih berat 27 kg dari A. Gabungan berat C dan A lebih berat 37 kg dari B. Tentukan jumlah berat A, B, dan C dalam kg.
hint_steps_en: Write the three clues as A+B = C+23, B+C = A+27, C+A = B+37.
Add them all: the left side becomes 2(A+B+C).
The right side is (A+B+C) + 23 + 27 + 37, so A+B+C = 87, choice B.
hint_steps_id: Tulis ketiga petunjuk: A+B = C+23, B+C = A+27, C+A = B+37.
Jumlahkan semua: sisi kiri menjadi 2(A+B+C).
Sisi kanan (A+B+C) + 23 + 27 + 37, jadi A+B+C = 87, pilihan B.

questions.body_en: Fill seven numbers 1 to 7 into three equations without repetition. In each equation, the number in □ is larger than the number in ○: □ + ○ = 7, □ × ○ = 12, □ − ○ = 2. If there are two or more possible sets of solutions, find the sum of all the unused numbers.

hint_steps_en: Start with the product equation = 12: it can be 4 x 3 or 6 x 2.
One full set is 4x3, 6+1, 7-5, which leaves out the 2.
The other set is 6x2, 4+3, 7-5, which leaves out the 1.
Both work, so add the leftovers: 2 + 1 = 3.
hint_steps_id: Mulai dengan persamaan hasil kali = 12: bisa 4 x 3 atau 6 x 2.
Satu susunan penuh: 4x3, 6+1, 7-5, menyisakan 2.
Susunan lain: 6x2, 4+3, 7-5, menyisakan 1.
Keduanya sah, jadi jumlahkan sisanya: 2 + 1 = 3.

questions.body_en: Write odd numbers 1 to 39 in order to form a string of digits: 135791113…3739. Delete 30 digits and keep the 5 remaining digits in their original order to form the largest possible 5-digit even number. What is this 5-digit number?

hint_steps_en: Write the digits in order: 1 3 5 7 9 1 1 1 3 and so on up to 3 7 3 9.
An even number must END in an even digit; the only even digits here are the 2s.
Keep the two biggest 9s in front, then 5, 7, and finish on a 2.
The largest even 5-digit number is 99572.
hint_steps_id: Tulis angka berurutan: 1 3 5 7 9 1 1 1 3 dan seterusnya sampai 3 7 3 9.
Bilangan genap harus BERAKHIR angka genap; satu-satunya angka genap di sini adalah 2.
Simpan dua angka 9 terbesar di depan, lalu 5, 7, dan akhiri dengan 2.
Bilangan genap 5 digit terbesar adalah 99572.

questions.body_en: Add 0s after the digit in each square to make the equations hold. Each square can have more than one 0 or none. When the two equations are completed, how many 0s are added in total? (1) □4 + □4 + □8 + □9 + □7 = 901; (2) □5 + □7 + □1 − □8 = 95.

Ketika kedua persamaan selesai, berapa banyak angka 0 yang ditambahkan secara keseluruhan? (1) □4 + □4 + □8 + □9 + □7 = 901; (2) □5 + □7 + □1 − □8 = 95.
hint_steps_en: Each square digit can grow by adding 0s after it, so 4 can become 40 or 400.
Choose how many 0s each digit needs so equation (1) totals 901.
Do the same so equation (2) totals 95.
Counting all the 0s used in both equations gives 7.
hint_steps_id: Angka tiap kotak bisa tumbuh dengan menambah 0 di belakangnya, jadi 4 bisa jadi 40 atau 400.
Pilih berapa 0 tiap angka agar persamaan (1) berjumlah 901.
Lakukan hal sama agar persamaan (2) berjumlah 95.
Menghitung semua 0 yang dipakai di kedua persamaan memberi 7.

questions.body_en: Use the ten digits 0 to 9 to form five 2-digit numbers where each digit is used exactly once. If the sum of these five numbers is an odd number, find the maximum value of the sum.
questions.body_id: Gunakan sepuluh angka 0 sampai 9 untuk membentuk lima bilangan 2 digit di mana setiap angka digunakan tepat sekali. Jika jumlah kelima bilangan tersebut adalah bilangan ganjil, tentukan nilai maksimum jumlahnya.
hint_steps_en: To make the sum big, put the five largest digits (5 to 9) in the tens places: that is 350.
The five smallest (0 to 4) go in the units: that adds 10, giving 360, but 360 is even.
Lower the total by the smallest odd amount, 9, by swapping a tens digit and a units digit.
360 - 9 = 351, which is odd and the largest possible.
hint_steps_id: Agar jumlahnya besar, taruh lima angka terbesar (5 sampai 9) di puluhan: itu 350.
Lima terkecil (0 sampai 4) di satuan: menambah 10, jadi 360, tetapi 360 genap.
Turunkan total sekecil mungkin, yaitu 9, dengan menukar satu angka puluhan dan satuan.
360 - 9 = 351, ganjil dan terbesar yang mungkin.

Try his car at 21: to the left, 11+13+15+17+19 = 75.
To the right, 23+25+27 = 75, the two sides match.
So his parking space is 21.
hint_steps_id: Coba mobilnya di 21: di kiri, 11+13+15+17+19 = 75.
Di kanan, 23+25+27 = 75, kedua sisi sama.
Jadi tempat parkirnya 21.

questions.body_en: Tom and Jerry played rock-paper-scissors. Winning with rock earns 6 points, winning with scissors earns 3 points, and winning with paper earns 7 points. The loser does not gain or lose any points. They played ten times where each of them won five times. Tom got 26 points and Jerry got 32 points. How many times did Jerry throw rock?
questions.body_id: Tom dan Jerry bermain suit (batu-gunting-kertas). Menang dengan batu mendapat 6 poin, menang dengan gunting mendapat 3 poin, dan menang dengan kertas mendapat 7 poin. Pihak yang kalah tidak mendapat atau kehilangan poin. Mereka bermain sepuluh kali di mana masing-masing menang lima kali. Tom mendapat 26 poin dan Jerry mendapat 32 poin. Berapa kali Jerry melempar batu?
hint_steps_en: Jerry 5 wins make 32 points: that must be 6+6+6+7+7, so he won with rock 3 times and paper 2 times.
Tom 5 wins make 26 points: 6+3+3+7+7, so Tom won with paper twice.
Paper beats rock, so in those 2 games Jerry threw rock and lost.
Jerry threw rock 3 (wins) + 2 (losses) = 5 times.
hint_steps_id: 5 kemenangan Jerry bernilai 32 poin: itu pasti 6+6+6+7+7, jadi ia menang dengan batu 3 kali dan kertas 2 kali.
5 kemenangan Tom bernilai 26 poin: 6+3+3+7+7, jadi Tom menang dengan kertas dua kali.
Kertas mengalahkan batu, jadi di 2 game itu Jerry melempar batu dan kalah.
Jerry melempar batu 3 (menang) + 2 (kalah) = 5 kali.

questions.body_en: Each square in the 4 × 4 grid has 1 black Go stone or 1 white Go stone. Each Go stone must be adjacent to at least 1 black Go stone and 1 white Go stone (adjacent means sharing a common side). How many black Go stones can be placed on the board at most?
questions.body_id: Setiap kotak dalam kisi 4 × 4 memiliki 1 batu Go hitam atau 1 batu Go putih. Setiap batu Go harus bersebelahan dengan setidaknya 1 batu Go hitam dan 1 batu Go putih (bersebelahan berarti berbagi sisi yang sama). Berapa banyak batu Go hitam yang dapat diletakkan di papan paling banyak?
hint_steps_en: The board has 4 x 4 = 16 squares.
You cannot make them all black: every black needs a white neighbour, and every white needs a black neighbour.
Placing 6 white stones cleverly lets every stone obey the rule.
That leaves 16 - 6 = 10 black stones at most.
hint_steps_id: Papan punya 4 x 4 = 16 kotak.
Tidak bisa semua hitam: tiap hitam butuh tetangga putih, dan tiap putih butuh tetangga hitam.
Menaruh 6 batu putih dengan cerdik membuat setiap batu menaati aturan.
Sisanya 16 - 6 = 10 batu hitam paling banyak.

questions.body_en: Begin from START. Throw a die with numbers 1 to 6 to determine the number of steps to go. If a player reaches squares 3, 7, 10, or 14, they must immediately move to the corresponding linked places. If a player gets the exact number to reach FINISH, they stay there. If the number is too large, they go to FINISH and then go backwards to finish their steps. Andrew gets 6, 6, and 4 and happens to reach FINISH. If he gets 6, 6, and 5, he must go backwards from FINISH to square 15. If he gets 3, ◇, and △ and happens to reach FINISH, find the sum of all possible values of ◇ × △.
questions.body_id: Mulai dari START. Lempar dadu dengan angka 1 sampai 6 untuk menentukan jumlah langkah. Jika pemain mencapai kotak 3, 7, 10, atau 14, mereka harus segera pindah ke tempat yang ditautkan. Jika pemain mendapatkan angka tepat untuk mencapai FINISH, mereka tetap di sana. Jika angkanya terlalu besar, mereka pergi ke FINISH lalu mundur untuk menyelesaikan langkah-langkah mereka. Andrew melempar 6, 6, dan 4 dan tepat mencapai FINISH. Jika ia melempar 6, 6, dan 5, ia harus mundur dari FINISH ke kotak 15. Jika ia melempar 3, ◇, dan △ dan tepat mencapai FINISH, tentukan jumlah semua kemungkinan nilai ◇ × △.
hint_steps_en: First roll is 3: you land on square 3, which is linked and jumps you to square 13.
From 13 you need two more rolls to land exactly on FINISH (square 16).
The pairs that work are (2,1), (4,1), and (6,3); the last two bounce back off FINISH.
Their products are 2, 4, and 18, so the sum is 2 + 4 + 18 = 24.
hint_steps_id: Lemparan pertama 3: kamu mendarat di kotak 3, yang tertaut dan melompatkanmu ke kotak 13.
Dari 13 kamu butuh dua lemparan lagi agar tepat di FINISH (kotak 16).
Pasangan yang berhasil: (2,1), (4,1), dan (6,3); dua terakhir memantul dari FINISH.
Hasil kalinya 2, 4, dan 18, jadi jumlahnya 2 + 4 + 18 = 24.

questions.body_en: Fill numbers 1 to 9 in the squares so that each row has numbers 1 to 9. Each number in the circle below is the sum of the three numbers in the squares directly above it, and the three numbers in each vertical group of squares are all different. The sums shown are 15, 17, 14, 18, 13, 16, 9, 16, 17. Find ● + ♦ − ★.
questions.body_id: Isikan bilangan 1 sampai 9 di dalam kotak-kotak sehingga setiap baris memiliki bilangan 1 sampai 9. Setiap bilangan di dalam lingkaran di bawah adalah jumlah tiga bilangan di dalam kotak yang tepat di atasnya, dan tiga bilangan di setiap kelompok kotak vertikal semuanya berbeda. Jumlah yang ditunjukkan adalah 15, 17, 14, 18, 13, 16, 9, 16, 17. Tentukan ● + ♦ − ★.
hint_steps_en: Each circle is the sum of the three squares above it, and every row uses 1 to 9 once.
Working column by column forces the dot = 7, the diamond = 8, and the star = 5.
So dot + diamond - star = 7 + 8 - 5 = 10.
hint_steps_id: Tiap lingkaran adalah jumlah tiga kotak di atasnya, dan tiap baris memakai 1 sampai 9 sekali.
Mengerjakan kolom demi kolom memaksa titik = 7, wajik = 8, dan bintang = 5.
Jadi titik + wajik - bintang = 7 + 8 - 5 = 10.
